label: Side Vents
description: Side vents — two symmetrical vertical slits at the rear side seams — are the hallmark of British tailoring and the most functionally satisfying of all vent options. They allow the jacket to open evenly on both sides when the wearer sits or reaches into trouser pockets, meaning the back drapes flat and uninterrupted whether standing or moving. The double vent is considered the most refined option in classic English dress, communicating an understanding of tailoring tradition without any overt showiness, and is the standard configuration on Savile Row bespoke.
